mapper.select: SELECT session.id AS session_id, session.expires_at AS session_expires_at, account.id, account.username, account.email, account.password_hash, account.display_name, account.avatar_url, account.storage_quota_bytes, account.is_enabled, account.created_at FROM auth_session session INNER JOIN user_account account ON account.id = session.user_id WHERE session.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND session.revoked_at IS NULL AND session.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND account.is_enabled = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_session SET revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE auth_session SET last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at FROM auth_session WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_session SET revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at FROM auth_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

SELECT id, user_agent, created_at, last_seen_at, expires_at, (id = #{currentSessionId}) AS is_current FROM auth_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM auth_session WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) OR revoked_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT #{limit}
